nodes.name: ADR-002 Frontend Architecture
nodes.description: Decision record establishing frontend technology stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, React Router, TanStack Query, and Supabase Client integration
nodes.rationale: Standardized tech stack after initial development phase to ensure team consistency and development speed

nodes.name: ADR-003 Performance Optimization
nodes.description: Comprehensive performance optimization patterns including query consolidation, TanStack Query caching, virtualization, lazy loading, batch queries, and studio state management
nodes.rationale: Systematic approach to address performance issues as functionality and data volume grew, reducing requests by ~70%

nodes.name: ADR-004 Audio Playback Optimization
nodes.description: Multi-level audio system optimization using AudioContext master clock, IndexedDB caching, Service Worker for offline access, debounced controls, stem virtualization, and optimistic UI
nodes.rationale: Addressed synchronization and performance issues when working with 4-6+ audio files simultaneously in the studio

nodes.name: ADR-004 Error Handling Architecture
nodes.description: Typed error hierarchy with AppError base class, error metadata for recovery strategies, Result type for functional error handling, and retry with backoff
nodes.rationale: Unified scattered error handling patterns to provide consistent UX and enable proper retry logic

nodes.name: ADR-005 State Machine Architecture
nodes.description: Lightweight TypeScript state machine implementation using discriminated unions for complex UI flows like Lyrics Wizard and Generation, avoiding XState overhead
nodes.rationale: Replaced loose state with boolean flags that led to invalid states and difficult transitions

nodes.name: ADR-006 Type-Safe AudioContext
nodes.description: Centralized audioContextHelper module for browser-compatible AudioContext creation eliminating 'as any' casts and providing type-safe factory functions
nodes.rationale: Addressed scattered webkitAudioContext casts that bypassed TypeScript and created maintenance burden

nodes.name: ADR-011 Unified Studio Architecture
nodes.description: DAW canvas integration unifying three parallel studio implementations into UnifiedDAWLayout without tabs, reusing DAWTimeline and DAWTrackLane components
nodes.rationale: Eliminated code duplication (~40%) and inconsistent UX patterns while maintaining backward compatibility

nodes.name: ADR-012 Generation Form Compact UI
nodes.description: UI optimization for generation form removing redundant elements, replacing tooltips with touch-friendly popovers, conditional button display, and compact lyrics editor
nodes.rationale: Addressed UX issues on mobile devices including non-functional tooltips and excessive header space usage

nodes.label: Single AudioContext Pattern
nodes.description: Centralized singleton AudioContext manager to prevent conflicts between multiple audio system components. Replaces separate AudioContext instances in GlobalAudioProvider, useAudioVisualizer, and AudioVisualizer with unified audioContextManager.

nodes.label: Fixed Audio Architecture
nodes.description: Production-ready audio architecture with single AudioContext, centralized state, protected MediaElementSource, and graceful fallback. Achieves 100% audio playback reliability with comprehensive testing (25 tests).

nodes.label: Audio Element Pooling
nodes.description: iOS Safari crash prevention through audio element pooling. iOS limits audio elements to 10, requiring reuse strategy via audioElementPool.ts to prevent app crashes with multiple audio tracks.

nodes.label: Audio Upload Flow
nodes.description: Complete audio upload and processing flow for both Web App and Telegram Bot interfaces. Covers upload, action selection (cover/extend), storage upload to Supabase, SunoAPI integration, and callback processing.

nodes.label: Telegram Audio Upload
nodes.description: Telegram bot audio upload flow with file download from Telegram, base64 conversion, Supabase storage upload, and SunoAPI integration. Supports both command-first and audio-first interaction patterns.

nodes.label: Audit System Implementation
nodes.description: Comprehensive audit logging system for copyright protection and proof of authorship. Tracks all content creation actions with cryptographic hashes, capturing user-initiated and AI-generated actions in content_audit_log and content_deposits tables.

nodes.label: Deposit Document Structure
nodes.description: JSON document structure for proof-of-creation with author information, content details, creation chain, input prompts, reference audio, and SHA-256 document hash. Designed for integration with blockchain anchoring and timestamping services.

nodes.label: Framer Motion Optimization
nodes.description: Tree-shakeable framer-motion exports via @/lib/motion wrapper. Provides motion, AnimatePresence, hooks (useAnimation, useMotionValue, useSpring), and animation presets (fadeIn, slideUp, scaleIn) while maintaining ~58KB bundle size.

nodes.label: Component Lazy Loading
nodes.description: Lazy loading strategy for heavy components via @/components/lazy including LazyGenerateSheet, LazyLyricsChatAssistant, LazyTrackDetailSheet, LazyAudioVisualizer, LazyMusicGraph, and LazyOnboardingSlider with Suspense fallback.

nodes.label: System Architecture Overview
nodes.description: High-level Telegram Mini App architecture with React 19 frontend, Zustand state management, Tone.js audio engine, Supabase backend, and Suno AI integration. 828 components, 263 hooks (48,812 lines), 100+ edge functions, 30+ database tables.

nodes.label: Data Flow Patterns
nodes.description: Three primary data flows: music generation (form → edge function → Suno API → database → notification), real-time audio (track selection → Global Audio Provider → HTMLAudioElement → player modes), and state synchronization (optimistic UI → edge function → database → real-time channel → UI re-render).

nodes.label: State Management Strategy
nodes.description: Multi-tier state management: Zustand stores for global UI state (player, studio, lyrics), TanStack Query for server state with optimized caching (5min stale, 10min gcTime), React Hook Form + Zod for form state with auto-save drafts (30min expiry), and React hooks for component state.

nodes.label: Contextual Hints System
nodes.description: Automated contextual hint system providing periodic tips based on user behavior and context. Uses useContextualHints hook for state management, ContextualHint component for display, and localStorage for persistence with configurable show conditions (routes, visits, cooldown, max shows).

nodes.label: Realtime Chord Detection
nodes.description: Real-time guitar chord detection through microphone using Web Audio API. Chromagram analysis with 12 pitch classes, chord template matching for major/minor/dim/aug/7th chords, FFT analysis (8192 size), and confidence threshold (>0.6).

nodes.label: Guitar Tab Editor
nodes.description: Interactive guitar tablature editor with 6-string canvas rendering, support for techniques (hammer-on, pull-off, slide, bend), undo/redo functionality, MIDI synth playback, and export to GP5/PDF/MIDI formats.

nodes.label: Melody Mixer
nodes.description: DJ-style melody creation interface with 8 style slots (0-100% weight), master controls (BPM, key, scale), real-time Tone.js preview, recording capability, and integration with music generation as audio reference.

nodes.label: Telegram Authentication Security
nodes.description: Security-critical Telegram Mini App authentication flow via telegram-auth edge function. Handles user data integrity validation with cryptographic signatures, user profile creation, session management, and JWT token generation. LOCKED status - requires extreme caution.

nodes.label: Authentication Flow Security
nodes.description: Secure authentication flow: client validates with Telegram WebApp SDK → edge function validates cryptographic signature → user profile created/updated via trigger → session token returned → Supabase authentication for subsequent requests.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database Schema
nodes.description: PostgreSQL database with Row Level Security (RLS) managing tracks with A/B versioning, playlists, artists, stem separation, 174+ Suno meta tags, 277+ music styles, 500+ tag relationships, user preferences, and generation history. 30+ tables, 50+ policies, 60+ indexes, 15+ triggers.

nodes.label: Track Versioning System
nodes.description: A/B track versioning system where each generation creates 2 versions (clip_index 0/1, version_label A/B, is_primary boolean). Active version managed via tracks.active_version_id foreign key. All changes logged in track_change_log with change_type, old_value, new_value.

nodes.label: Tag Relationship Graph
nodes.description: Graph-structured tag system with 174+ suno_meta_tags, 277+ music_styles, 500+ tag_relationships edges. Supports relationship types (complements, conflicts, enhances, requires), strength scoring (1-10), and recursive complementary tag search via get_complementary_tags() function.

nodes.label: Guest Mode Implementation
nodes.description: Guest mode for viewing interface without Telegram authorization. Implemented via GuestModeContext, GuestModeBanner indicator, useGuestAccess hook, and ProtectedRoute modifications. Allows public content viewing, navigation, and playback while restricting content creation, editing, and likes.

nodes.label: Typography Scale
nodes.description: Semantic typography system with display sizes (2.5rem/40px to 2rem/32px), heading hierarchy (1.5rem/24px to 1.125rem/18px), body text (1rem/16px to 0.75rem/12px), and caption text (0.6875rem/11px). Uses Inter font family with responsive scaling via mobile-first approach.

nodes.label: Spacing System
nodes.description: 4px-based spacing grid with semantic tokens from --space-1 (4px) to --space-12 (48px). Supports adaptive spacing with responsive classes (p-3 md:p-4 lg:p-6) and gap management for flex/grid layouts (gap-2 to gap-6).

nodes.label: Safe Area Implementation
nodes.description: Telegram Mini App safe area system accounting for iOS notch/Dynamic Island and native buttons. Uses CSS variables (--tg-safe-area-inset-top/bottom, --tg-content-safe-area-inset-top/bottom) and env(safe-area-inset-*) with typical values: iPhone 15 Pro (59px/34px), iPhone SE (44px/34px), Android (24px/0px).

nodes.label: Development Environment Setup
nodes.description: Developer onboarding process requiring Node.js v18+, npm v9+, Git, VS Code, and Telegram for testing. Initial setup includes repository clone, npm install, environment variable configuration (.env.example → .env), and dev server startup on localhost:8080.

nodes.label: Development Workflow
nodes.description: Daily development workflow: git pull → feature branch creation → npm run dev → code changes → npm test + npm run test:e2e → npm run lint → npm run format → conventional commit → git push → pull request creation with branch naming (feature/, fix/, refactor/, docs/, test/, chore/).

nodes.label: GitFlow Workflow
nodes.description: GitFlow branching strategy with main (production-ready), develop (integration), feature/* (new features), bugfix/* (bug fixes), and hotfix/* (production emergencies). All pull requests require minimum one team member review using PR template.

nodes.label: Error Handling Infrastructure
nodes.description: Comprehensive error handling with structured error types (AppError base class with 8 specialized types: ValidationError, NetworkError, AuthError, NotFoundError, PermissionError, RateLimitError, ServiceUnavailableError), retry logic with exponential backoff, enhanced ErrorBoundary with user-friendly Russian messages, and utility functions for error handling.

nodes.label: Retry Logic with Exponential Backoff
nodes.description: Automatic retry mechanism for transient failures with configurable maxRetries (default 3), initialDelay (1000ms), maxDelay (10000ms), and backoffFactor (2). Includes retryFetch wrapper for automatic 5xx error retries and network failure recovery.

nodes.label: Suno AI Music Generation
nodes.description: Suno AI v5 integration with A/B versioning (2 variants per request), streaming preview during generation, custom mode with full lyrics control, audio reference for covers/extends, and section replacement. Edge functions: suno-music-generate, suno-music-callback, generate-track-cover.

nodes.label: Generation Modes
nodes.description: Two generation modes: Simple mode (prompt, style, instrumental flag for quick generation) and Custom mode (lyrics with section tags, style prompt, title, negative tags for full control). Supports Suno API limits: prompt 500 chars, style 500 chars, title 80 chars, lyrics 3000 chars.

nodes.label: Callback Processing Flow
nodes.description: Asynchronous webhook flow: Suno AI POST to suno-music-callback → HMAC signature validation → generation_task update → streaming URL update OR track_versions creation + active_version_id update → custom cover generation → Telegram notification. Includes error handling and recovery.

nodes.label: Audio System Hooks
nodes.description: 25+ audio system hooks organized by category: player state and control (usePlayerStore - 200 lines), playback queue management (usePlaybackQueue - 150 lines), optimized audio player with caching (useOptimizedAudioPlayer - 375 lines), waveform visualization (useWaveform - 200 lines), and real-time visualizer (useAudioVisualizer - 180 lines).

nodes.label: Studio Production Hooks
nodes.description: 28+ studio and production hooks: multi-track audio engine (useStemAudioEngine - 320 lines), audio effects chain (useAudioEffectsChain - 280 lines), mix export (useMixExport - 372 lines), loop region management (useLoopRegion - 240 lines), and undo/redo state (useUndoRedo - 200 lines).

nodes.label: Generation Hooks

nodes.label: iOS Input Zoom Prevention
nodes.description: iOS Safari zoom prevention on input focus by enforcing text-base (16px) font size on all form inputs, global CSS rule forcing 16px for inputs, and touch-manipulation to prevent double-tap zoom. Affects input.tsx, textarea.tsx, select.tsx, and index.css.

nodes.label: iOS Keyboard Height Tracking

nodes.label: Klang.io Music Transcription
nodes.description: AI-powered music transcription system converting audio to editable notation (sheet music, MIDI, MusicXML, GP5, PDF, TAB). Serves 15,000+ daily transcriptions supporting vocals, piano, drums, guitar, bass, synth, strings, and winds with proprietary AI models.

nodes.label: Klang.io Format Support
nodes.description: Multiple format support: MIDI (quantized/unquantized with velocity detection), MusicXML (editable notation compatible with MuseScore/Sibelius/Finale), PDF (sheet music with notation, rhythm, tempo, chords), Guitar Pro GP5 (TAB notation with effects), and TAB (tablature for guitar/bass).

nodes.label: Klang.io REST API Endpoints
nodes.description: REST API integration with POST /api/v1/transcribe for file upload, webhook callback for results, and REST hooks for event registration. Authentication via X-KLANG-API-KEY and X-KLANG-API-SECRET headers. Returns transcription with MIDI/MusicXML base64, notes array, chords, and tempo data.

nodes.label: Klang.io Integration Patterns

Features retry logic with exponential backoff, input validation (format/size checks), webhook signature verification, result caching, and performance optimization with worker threads.
